identitySupervision: Cross entropy only for expert-correct components; expert-error and ambiguous components do not invent an identity label.
validitySupervision: For a correct component: expected-class positive BCE and mean other-class negative BCE, each half per root. For an expert-error component: expected-class negative BCE only. Correct/error group means receive equal weight; ambiguous components are masked.
outputCombination: log-softmax identity plus log-sigmoid validity; runtime softmax normalizes the full-class product and does not preserve absolute validity.
